summary: Model Risk Management Analyst, AVP candidate with ~7 years across independent model validation, model governance, and quantitative risk analytics. Exercises delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, and sits on the model governance committee covering methodology review, benchmarking, and model-performance assessment. Statistical, stochastic, and Python-based modelling depth; IFRS 9 transformation delivery at EY. CFA charterholder, dual MSc.
core_skills: Statistical Analysis, Stochastic & Monte Carlo Modelling

sections.heading: Independent Model Validation & Review
bullets: Exercise delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Operate within a formal model-governance framework - reviewing assumptions, validating economic defensibility, and documenting review outcomes to standards consistent with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 expectations.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates.
Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM and capital processes.

sections.heading: Model Governance & Escalation Management
bullets: Serve on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

Escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility; serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, working with product owners and clients' Heads of Risk to drive resolution.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls, supporting model-governance requirements on reproducibility and versioning.

sections.heading: Quantitative Modelling, Stress Testing & Reporting
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenario analysis across multi-year horizons.
Embedded behavioral cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays aligned with regulatory liquidity expectations.
Oversee interest-rate and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks for institutional client balance sheets.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection - reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.
Prepare analytical summaries translating quantitative output into rate-exposure, scenario-impact, and balance-sheet narratives for senior non-technical stakeholders.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms on PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management), validating model outputs post-deployment.
Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, translating requirements into scoped development requests.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT, and program-management functions on standard adoption; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.

Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators using statistical analysis and Monte Carlo simulation to assess interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier analysis to test robustness of recommendations.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet exposures.
Presented study findings and methodology assumptions to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
